source.title: Why Your Enterprise Tech Stack Isn't Ready for AI Agents - And What to Build Instead
source.date_note: Conference session date verified from the official event schedule; YouTube upload date not independently verified.

inspection.method: Source analysis used transcript-derived material for the talk, official conference metadata for date verification, and official documentation for adjacent-tool enrichment.
gaps: YouTube upload date was not independently verified.

content_map.problem: Agent proofs of concept can demonstrate task capability while omitting the control, state and governance properties required for production work.
content_map.thesis: Production agent systems need an execution substrate around the model so work can be authorized, observed, handed to humans, reconstructed and replayed.
sections: separation of execution and protected data
human and agent executors of the same task
replay as a production evaluation primitive
mechanisms: record execution as reconstructable events rather than relying only on developer logs
keep orchestration references separate from protected data objects
model tasks independently from whether the executor is AI or human
replay reconstructable historical cases against changed models, prompts, policies or tools
examples: consequential business actions that require approval and later auditability
claims: A working agent POC does not establish production readiness.
Reconstructable execution state enables stronger audit and evaluation patterns.
Human escalation is cleaner when task contracts are independent from executor type.
evidence: Architecture patterns are presented from the speakers' experience deploying agents in a regulated environment.
assumptions: The workflow performs consequential actions rather than only generating advisory text.
The organization requires authorization, governance or post-hoc explanation.
limitations: An immutable history alone does not supply identity evidence, retention, tamper protection or event semantics.
Data-plane separation reduces exposure but does not eliminate injection or exfiltration risks.
Human handoff still requires ownership, locking, idempotency, timeout and recovery semantics.
Replay is only trustworthy when the reconstructed state and evaluation criteria are trustworthy.
open_questions: Which production-agent platforms will standardize identity, policy, human handoff and replay as common primitives?
What is the smallest useful implementation of this execution substrate for a custom agent workflow?

selection.requested_focus: Understand the concepts, architecture patterns, useful tools and practical implications. Preserve the whole mental model rather than isolated highlights.
coherent_core: The model is only one executor inside a larger controlled execution system.
Execution history, protected-data access, executor-independent tasks and replay reinforce each other and should be understood as one architecture model.
Production readiness is better tested by whether consequential work can later be explained and reconstructed than by whether a demo returns the right output.
prerequisites: basic understanding of agent tool calls
difference between application logs and reconstructable execution state
basic idea of authorization and human approval
drop_notes: Presentation framing and repeated POC-versus-production rhetoric are compressed after the distinction is established.
SAP is retained only as one optional application example, not as the primary frame.

verification_candidates.question: What workflow system is useful for learning durable execution semantics?
verification_candidates.reason: The talk motivates durable/reconstructable execution but does not need to prescribe one implementation.

verification_candidates.question: Which standard is useful for learning distributed observability concepts?
verification_candidates.reason: Observability is adjacent to execution reconstruction and should be distinguished from it.

verification_candidates.question: What concrete system demonstrates policy-as-code outside application logic?
verification_candidates.reason: Authorization/policy is central to controlled execution and benefits from a practical learning tool.
